w10_P4_002206: The final figure in a cart-fleet report, in kJ, is 13 kJ of reserve added to a fleet total. The fleet total is 8 times a pair figure that is expressed in kJ. The pair figure is the combined energy of motion of 2 identical carts. Each cart has a mass of 40 kg and moves at a speed in m/s equal to the second derivative of y = 1·x³ + 3x² evaluated at x = 1. What is the final figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_002209: An 89,000 g crate is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the area under y = 3x² + 4x between x = 1 and x = 3. The drive must supply the force for this plus 28 N of roller friction, less 8 N of incline assist. The result is converted to kN. Ten such drives operate, so the plant figure is 10 times the per-drive value. What is the plant figure, in kN?
w10_P4_002210: The final figure on a hoist sheet, in kN, is 22 kN of counterweight assist subtracted from a subtotal. The subtotal is 28 kN of structural allowance added to a combined force expressed in kN. The combined force is that of 3 identical hoists, each supplying the force needed to accelerate a 174,000 g load at a rate in m/s² equal to the number of ways to choose 2 items from a set of 11. What is the final figure, in kN?
w10_P4_002211: A 9,000 g package on a sorting chute moves at a speed in m/s equal to the sum of the whole numbers from 1 to 6. Ten packages ride at once, so the combined energy of motion is 10 times that of one package, and the combined value is converted to kJ. The depot subtracts a 20 kJ budget from that value. It then adds a 25 kJ reserve. What is the resulting figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_002217: The figure a crane operator records, in kN, is 8 times a single-cable net force that is expressed in kN. The single-cable net force is 7 N less than the force needed to accelerate a 176,000 g load at a rate in m/s² equal to the slope of the curve y = 3x³ - 4x² at the point x = 1. Eight identical cables share the load. What figure does the operator record, in kN?
w10_P4_002218: The final figure in a press-test report, in kN, is 3 times a per-ram net force, with the pressing direction positive, so it may be negative. The per-ram net force is a drive force expressed in kN minus a 6 kN return-spring load. The drive force is what is needed to accelerate a 77 kg die at a rate in m/s² equal to 2 times the smaller root of x² - 6x + 5 = 0. The press stroke is 20 cm. What is the final figure, in kN?
w10_P4_002222: A 38,000 g cargo bike moves at a speed in m/s equal to the slope of the curve y = 5x³ + 5x² at the point x = 1. A depot has 9 such bikes, so the depot's combined energy of motion is 9 times that of one bike. From the depot value, 27 J of timing loss is subtracted. There are 8 depots per region and 4 regions, so the company total is the per-depot value multiplied by 8 and then by 4. What is the company total, in J?
w10_P4_002234: The final figure in a plant report, in kN, is 5 times a hall total. The hall total is 5 times a single-drive net force expressed in kN. The single-drive net force is 22 N less than the force needed to accelerate a 74 kg crate at a rate in m/s² equal to the greatest common divisor of 60 and 200. What is the final figure, in kN?
w10_P4_002235: The total on a lift sheet, in kN, is 5 times a shaft total. The shaft total is 6 times a single-motor force expressed in kN. The single-motor force is 3 N more than the force needed to accelerate an 80,000 g cabin at a rate in m/s² equal to the smaller root of x² - 8x + 15 = 0. The shaft is 30 m tall. What is the total on the lift sheet, in kN?
w10_P4_002245: A 16 kg drone flies at a speed in m/s equal to 4 times the sum of 5 and 3. A squadron of 8 drones has a combined energy of motion 8 times that of one drone, and the operator converts the squadron value to kJ. The drones fly at an altitude of 200 m. There are 8 squadrons per wing and 2 wings, so the total is the squadron value multiplied by 8 and then by 2. What is the total, in kJ?
w10_P4_002257: A rider and bike with a combined mass of 60,000 g move at a speed in m/s equal to 8 times the greatest common divisor of 279 and 80. Two riders form a pair, so the pair's combined energy of motion is twice that of one rider. Nine pairs race, so the race total is 9 times the pair value. From the race total, 1 J of timing loss is subtracted. What is the resulting figure, in J?
w10_P4_002258: The final figure on a crane load sheet, in kN, is 10 kN of wind allowance added to a combined force expressed in kN. The combined force is that of 2 cranes, each with 5 identical hoists, so it is the single-hoist force multiplied by 5 and then by 2. A single hoist supplies the force needed to accelerate a 121 kg load at a rate in m/s² equal to the larger root of x² - 12x + 32 = 0. What is the final figure, in kN?
w10_P4_002261: The total in a race-team energy report, in J, is 9 times a heat figure. The heat figure is 2 times a per-kart figure. The per-kart figure is 16 J of stored spring energy added to the energy of motion of a 25 kg kart. The kart moves at a speed in m/s equal to the second derivative of y = 2x³ - 1·x² evaluated at x = 3. What is the total in the report, in J?
w10_P4_002271: The total in a courier report, in kJ, is 5 times a depot figure. The depot figure is 7 times a per-bike figure expressed in kJ. The per-bike figure is the energy of motion of a 33,000 g cargo bike moving at a speed in m/s equal to 12 times the greatest common divisor of 161 and 232. What is the total in the report, in kJ?
w10_P4_002274: The figure at the end of a cycling-club energy sheet, in kJ, is 10 times a per-rider balance. The per-rider balance is the energy of motion of a rider and bike, expressed in kJ, minus a 5 kJ energy budget, recorded as negative when the rider is under budget. The rider and bike together have a mass of 48,000 g and move at a speed in m/s equal to the larger root of x² - 6x + 8 = 0. What figure ends the sheet, in kJ?
w10_P4_002281: The final line of a press-test sheet is a net force in kN, found by subtracting a 22 kN return-spring load from a drive force expressed in kN, with the pressing direction positive, so it may be negative. The drive force is obtained by taking the force needed to accelerate a 97 kg die at a rate in m/s² equal to the smaller root of x² - 4x + 3 = 0, adding 19 N of guide friction, and then subtracting 24 N of incline assist. What is on the final line, in kN?
w10_P4_002284: The final figure in a sled-test report, in kJ, is 25 kJ of reserve added to a net figure. The net figure is a sled's energy of motion, expressed in kJ, minus a 9 kJ braking allowance. The sled has a mass of 21,000 g and moves at a speed in m/s equal to 14 less than the area under y = 5x² + 5x between x = 1 and x = 3. What is the final figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_002286: A rider and bike with a combined mass of 57 kg roll at a speed in m/s equal to the greatest common divisor of 179 and 153. The energy of motion is converted to kJ. Two riders form a team, so the team value is twice that. The club records the team value minus a 15 kJ energy budget, negative when the team is under budget. What does the club record, in kJ?
w10_P4_002288: A 148 kg pallet on a warehouse conveyor is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the larger root of x² - 5x + 6 = 0. The drive force needed for this is converted to kN. There are 9 conveyors per floor, 8 floors per building, and 11 buildings. The site total is therefore the per-conveyor value multiplied by 9, then by 8, then by 11. What is the site total, in kN?
w10_P4_002290: A 44 kg projectile on a test range flies at a speed in m/s equal to the number of ways to choose 2 items from a set of 12. Its energy of motion, less 21 J of launch loss, is the per-shot figure. The range is 1.5 km long. Seven shots are fired, so the session figure is 7 times the per-shot value, and 17 J of sensor overhead is then subtracted. What is the final figure, in J?
w10_P4_002306: A 193 kg engine block on a factory hoist is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to 3 times the sum of 2 and 5. The hoist supplies the force needed for this, less 7 N contributed by a counter-spring. The hoist chain is 7 m long. There are 8 hoists per bay, 8 bays per hall, and 3 halls, so the plant total is the per-hoist value multiplied by 8, then by 8, then by 3. What is the plant total, in N?
w10_P4_002311: A 28 kg test sled moves at a speed in m/s equal to the second derivative of y = 4x³ - 2x² evaluated at x = 2. Its energy of motion is converted to kJ. The sled track is 350 m long. Four sleds run per session and 5 sessions are run, so the campaign total is the per-sled value multiplied by 4 and then by 5. What is the campaign total, in kJ?
w10_P4_002312: The total in a race-day energy report, in kJ, is 9 times a session figure. The session figure is a heat total converted from J to kJ. The heat total is 9 times a pair figure, and the pair figure is 2 times the energy of motion of a single kart. Each kart has a mass of 30,000 g and moves at a speed in m/s equal to 2 times the sum of 7 and 17. What is the total in the report, in kJ?
w10_P4_002314: A 44,000 g cargo bike on a delivery route moves at a speed in m/s equal to 2 times the sum of 7 and 13. Its energy of motion is measured. The logger subtracts 21 J of rolling loss, then adds 4 J of sensor offset, and then adds 26 J of stored spring energy. What energy does the logger report, in J?
w10_P4_002325: The total in a hoist report, in N, is 5 times a bay figure. The bay figure is 29 N less than the combined force of 4 identical hoists. Each hoist supplies the force needed to accelerate a 49,000 g load at a rate in m/s² equal to the smaller root of x² - 8x + 7 = 0. The hoist cable is 12 m long. What is the total in the report, in N?
